hero.title: A wooden retreat between two volcanoes and endless horizons
hero.description: Tiki is a living space in the rural heart of Ometepe, where natural wood architecture and the lake's gentle pace bring you back to what matters.

identity.label: Visual identity
identity.description: The volcanic duality aligned with the water's horizon.
identity.symbolLabel: Symbol of mountains, horizon and water

architecture.title: A handcrafted retreat at home in its rural surroundings
paragraphs: At Tiki, we believe true luxury is rest, connection with nature and closeness to others. Our structure is designed to breathe naturally with the breeze from Lake Cocibolca.
Here, nature sets the pace. Wake to birdsong, share food and stories, and discover the island's rural life.
features: Wooden Architecture Open to the Breeze
architecture.quote: “The wood creaks softly at night, reminding us that we are alive in the middle of the island.”

spaces.title: Spaces designed for connection and rest

cards.title: Private Wooden Cabins
cards.description: Handcrafted rooms for maximum privacy and direct contact with the surrounding nature.

cards.title: Shared Dormitories
cards.description: Solid native wood bunk beds with personal space and constant natural ventilation for travelers with a story to tell.

cards.title: Communal Kitchen & Fire Pit
cards.description: Open spaces where preparing local food, evening fires and conversations that inspire new journeys come together.

experience.title: Our essence lies in the hands that welcome you
paragraphs: Tiki is more than a point on the map; it is a temporary home run by people who love the island. We believe in warm, open and genuine hospitality.

Here you will not find plastic wristbands or corporate formalities. You will find freshly brewed coffee in the mornings, honest advice on exploring the local volcanic trails and deep respect for the calm of the surroundings.

contact.title: Want to map out your next journey with us?
contact.description: Please send us your enquiry directly. We do not manage automatic bookings so availability stays in sync and we respect the hostel's capacity.
